subject: Urgent: MAP re-baseline and conditional credit trigger for HealthOps close
messages:
From: Katie Morris <katie.morris@healthops.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthops.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Timeline impact — validation gating request / MAP update

Marcus —

Quick note from our side: the integration test window we planned for the week of Nov 15 has hit a blocker on our side (further environment hardening required). I wanted to flag the impact now because our security team is tying acceptance to that integration pass.

Concretely: the validation window will likely slip 7–10 business days unless we can run a targeted smoke validation earlier. We need the mutual action plan updated with (a) a compressed validation run option, (b) a fallback acceptance path if the smoke run fails, and (c) a clear credit trigger if acceptance misses the contracted go-live by more than 10 business days.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a 3‑day accelerated validation (narrow scope) and whether there is appetite for a conditional credit if the full acceptance window is missed? Procurement is already watching this — looping them.

Thanks,
Katie

--
Katie Morris
Head of Integrations, HealthOps
katie.morris@healthops.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Katie Morris <katie.morris@healthops.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Timeline impact — validation gating request / MAP update

Katie —

Thanks for the early heads-up — appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front: yes, we can run a scoped 3‑day accelerated validation; and we can propose a conditional credit structure tied to a slip beyond the 10 business‑day threshold.

Proposed next steps (we'll update the MAP draft and circulate):
- Scope: define the smoke validation test cases (critical paths only) — we can own execution and provide a triage channel.
- Schedule: tentative smoke window Nov 12–14 (we can shift if your environment hardening runs later).
- Fallback: if smoke fails, automatic rollback to the prior staging snapshot + hotfix sprint lane (our team will prioritize bugs for 48h TTR).
- Credit trigger: if full acceptance misses contracted go‑live by >10 business days, propose a pro‑rated usage credit equal to 15% of the first month's committed spend.

I attached an updated MAP stub (MAP_v2_20261106.xlsx) with the compressed validation option and the conditional credit clause in the governance section. Camila — can you confirm resource availability for the Nov 12–14 thin validation window and whether we need a dedicated infra engineer? Jordan — please weigh in on the credit language and legal escalation path.

Katie, Procurement — if the credit number above is a non‑starter, we can iterate — want to avoid blocking the go‑live cadence.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Katie Morris <katie.morris@healthops.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Timeline impact — validation gating request / MAP update

Marcus / Katie —

I'm good to staff the Nov 12–14 accelerated validation. I'll allocate one integration engineer (Srinivas) and one platform engineer (Elaine) for the three days, plus a 4‑hour overlap window each day for joint triage. I'll drop Srinivas into the HealthOps Slack channel and provide a lightweight runbook.

Regarding credits: Jordan and I discussed internally — 15% sounds defensible for initial offer. Jordan, can legal confirm that this can be documented as a one‑time, pro‑rated credit in the SOW amendment rather than an SLA amendment? If yes, we can present language to Procurement.

Attachments: HealthOps_EvalChecklist_v1.docx (proposed smoke test cases).

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Customer Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Procurement Team <procurement@healthops.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Morris <katie.morris@healthops.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Timeline impact — validation gating request / MAP update

Marcus / Camila —

Acknowledged. Procurement has reviewed the proposed conditional credit (15% pro‑rated) and the compressed 3‑day validation option. Two asks from our side before we sign off: (1) confirm the smoke test scope map aligns to the acceptance checklist in HealthOps_EvalChecklist_v1.docx, and (2) provide a DocuSign amendment with the credit clause and the updated MAP attached so we can route for internal approvals.

If you can get the amendment in the next 48 hours we can preserve our original commercial window; otherwise approvals will push the approval to the week of Nov 22.

Thanks —
Procurement Team
Procurement, HealthOps
procurement@healthops.com
